deliverables.title: Instagram Feed Prompt
deliverables.prompt: Create a warm, inviting composition for Instagram feed showing a rustic wooden table with two handcrafted sourdough loaves and cinnamon rolls. Natural light from a window illuminates the scene, highlighting the textures and colors. Soft, earthy palette with muted greens, warm beiges, and subtle browns. Composition emphasizes close-up details of the breads to evoke sensory appeal without health claims or pricing. No text overlays. Brand constraints: English language, no discounts, health claims, or invented testimonials. Exclusions: No opening hours, no product references, no pricing information. Format: 1080x1080 pixels, 1:1 aspect ratio. Target: Local residents planning a relaxed weekend breakfast. Must be photorealistic but stylized for Instagram.
